Read since 2026-11-21 (docs/decisions/2026-11-21-fish-phase-flag-from-cited-list.md): a sex or ip_tp yes gives the species' photos the phase flag p (tools/fish_judge.py phase_flag) and fish.json species phs, the sources the sex or colour phase card names (tools/build_fish.py phase_sources).
